records.title: security(cli): confine agent brief file paths to the workspace
records.release_claim: agent brief artifacts cannot embed caller-selected paths that escape the analyzed repository root
records.reason: The explicit file list bypassed the confinement already applied to parsed diffs and other agent inputs. Traversal, outside-root absolute paths, and platform prefixes now fail closed with a named error.
records.non_claim: Path confinement does not prove that every in-root file is relevant or safe to edit.
